attributes.title: Ingest - Notes (markdown)
attributes.visState:
{"title":"Ingest - Notes (markdown)","type":"markdown","aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":12,"openLinksInNewTab":false,"markdown":"### Reading this dashboard
* **Latest request** is the newest `@timestamp` (the request time). **Last ingested** is the newest `event.ingested` (when Logstash processed it). A stale *Last ingested* means the pipeline is not running or no new files arrived; a stale *Latest request* with a fresh *Last ingested* is a backlog load.
* Events that fail parsing are written to the bad-log file on the Logstash host and **never reach OpenSearch**, so they do not appear here. See the Operations Runbook, Bad logs.
* Quality tags are informational tags set by the pipeline on indexed events."}}

attributes.title: Errors - Notes (markdown)
attributes.visState:
{"title":"Errors - Notes (markdown)","type":"markdown","aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":12,"openLinksInNewTab":false,"markdown":"### Scope
* Counts cover requests that reached OpenSearch. Logstash drops requests with invalid or scanner-only HTTP methods (for example PRI, TRACE, Nessus) before indexing, so they are not counted.
* **Suspicious query** is a Logstash tag set when a query string contains `allow_url_include` or `auto_prepend_file` (PHP-CGI remote code execution probe).
* 404 and 5xx tables show paths; use *Top Error Sources* to find clients generating many errors across many paths."}}
